about.heading: I build AI agents and backends that scale.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Amit - a software engineer who builds Python backends and LLM agents that actually work in production. I think about scale: async queues, fault tolerance, observability. Recently shipped an agentic platform using LangGraph and AWS SQS where agents can research topics, write reports, and pause for human approval when needed. I care about systems that don't silently fail - whether that's RAG pipelines searching vectors or APIs handling real traffic. Right now I'm working on an Odoo platform that manages editorial workflows across multiple tenants.

projects.title: ClosrAI
projects.description:
Engineered a SQL-driven AI Sales Autopilot automating end-to-end prospecting and
reporting, saving 15+ hours of manual work weekly. Integrated Gemini 2.0 Flash and
OpenRouter with Apollo.io and Hunter.io APIs to generate hyper-personalized sales
content. Implemented asynchronous background task engine using APScheduler for
autonomous 24/7 sales operations with zero manual intervention. Automated 100% of
lead research and increased outreach quality with real-time personalization.

projects.title: AgentFlow
projects.description:
Architected a production-grade agentic task platform where users submit goals
and an autonomous agent plans, researches, and synthesizes reports with human-in-the-loop
approval. Built with LangGraph for state management, AWS SQS + DLQ for async execution,
Redis for idempotency and state tracking, and Next.js frontend with real-time SSE streaming.
Implemented structured JSON logging with trace IDs, per-step cost tracking (tokens + USD),
and fault-tolerant retry logic. Handles distributed failure modes gracefully.

projects.title: CollabCode
projects.description:
Built a real-time collaborative coding platform enabling multiple users to code
simultaneously with conflict-free syncing via Yjs CRDT. Integrated multi-user
video/audio conferencing with WebRTC delivering low-latency communication for
interviews and pair programming. Implemented real-time chat system for instant
participant communication. Optimized server load via debounced document persistence
and query optimization, achieving ~80% fewer database writes.

projects.title: PulseBoard
projects.description:
Built a multi-tenant real-time analytics SaaS where teams connect data sources
(CSV, PostgreSQL, REST APIs), define custom metrics, and see live-updating charts.
Implemented tenant-isolated PostgreSQL schemas for data separation, WebSocket fan-out
via Redis Pub/Sub for real-time updates to N concurrent clients, and Celery-based
metric refresh pipelines every 30s. Added RBAC (admin/editor/viewer roles), webhook
alerting with SQS + DLQ retry logic, and query optimization for large datasets.

projects.title: DevTrack
projects.description:
Built DevTrack Chrome Extension (MV3 compliant) tracking browsing activity
across 40+ domains with Pomodoro timer, idle detection, incognito awareness,
and per-domain todo/notes widget. Developed full-stack backend + React dashboard
with 25+ REST APIs, 6 analytics views, gamification engine (6 levels, points system),
streak tracking, and CSV/JSON export. Achieved 30s auto-refresh with debounced
persistence, reducing database load by 80%.

experience.note:
